Mehbooba Mufti Alleges BJP Undermining Indian Democracy

Mehbooba Mufti, a former Chief Minister of Jammu and Kashmir, has alleged that the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) is attempting to subvert the fundamental principles of Indian democracy. She specifically raised concerns over changes to electoral rolls, stating that "there will be no democracy." The reports do not specify the exact nature of the electoral roll changes or the specific actions by the BJP that Mufti is referring to.
